'''Molasses''' is an [[ingredient]] made by cooking sugar cane. It can't be eaten.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/molasses.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Sugar cane cooks into molasses in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. Picking up sugar cane unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

Molasses crafts into 3 [[sugar]], and 4 make a honey block. It is the sweetener in [[puerquito]]s. Obtaining molasses unlocks these recipes.

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Trivia ==
* Molasses is a renamed piglin spawn egg.
